steps.headline: Close #21 "Redo the review of the session-switch animation" as done?
steps.today: The item asks for the session-switch animation to be reviewed as live options to pick between.
steps.problem: That review happened: rounds 10 and 11 were live pick-one steps, you signed off round 11, and it shipped on Sept 3 (workspace commit 0eee2ed6, app pull request #404).
steps.proposal: Yes: it moves to Merged with that commit recorded in the shipped list. No: it stays in Planning.

steps.headline: Which of these idea lists should move back to Preliminary exploration?
steps.today: These items sit in Planning, but each is a list of ideas or parked thoughts nobody has decided to build.
steps.problem: Planning is meant to hold work that is thought through and doesn't overlap. Ideas there make it look like far more is ready than is.
steps.proposal: Each tick moves that item to Preliminary exploration, where overlap is allowed. Nothing is deleted. (Where an item is also in a combination above, the combined item moves.)

steps.path: Every item's chips on the management page
steps.headline: Should every item show whether it is a bug, a feature, a polish change or housekeeping?
steps.today: Items show their part of the app and their side (UI/UX Only, Backend Only, or both), but not what kind of work they are. The agents labelled all 143: 58 bugs, 46 features, 16 polish, 23 housekeeping (work you never see in the app).
steps.problem: You can't filter to "just the bugs" or see at a glance whether something is broken or optional.
steps.proposal: Yes: each item gets one of these four as a tag, so the existing tag filter shows "bug" etc. A combined item takes "bug" if any part is a bug. No: the labels are thrown away.
